title: Evidence export index
description: export-index.json in an evidence/v1 export: the unsigned list of the files of the export with digests and sizes, and the parts that are absent with the reason. The signed bundle-manifest.json covers this file. Not expressible here and checked by the verifier: the file is the canonical JSON form; 1 to 64 entries with unique paths (an exporter writes them sorted by path; a verifier does not check the order); each entry digest and size match the file; a part is never both listed in entries and named in absent; reason and owner are 1 to 512 bytes; at most 12 absent parts; the file is at most 1 MiB. The index lists neither itself nor bundle-manifest.json.

export_version.description: The export layout version; 1 in evidence/v1.

absent.description: Absent when no part is absent.

digest.description: A SHA-256 digest: the prefix sha256: and 64 lowercase hex characters.

path.description: A file of an export other than the index and the manifest, relative to the export directory.

size.description: File size in bytes; at most 256 MiB for records.ndjson and tool-events.ndjson and 1 MiB for every other file.

part.description: A part the design lists for an export; a trailing slash names a directory.

reason.description: Why the part is absent; 1 to 512 bytes.

owner.description: Who owns producing the part; 1 to 512 bytes.

not_applicable.description: Present and true when the part does not apply to this change; absent otherwise (false is never written).
